default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-988.title: TRIX zero-cross follow
E-988.hypothesis: Triple-smoothed log-price slope changing sign filters noise out; participants chasing the confirmed turn keep pushing.

E-989.title: Hull-style EMA slope turn follow
E-989.hypothesis: A low-lag average changing slope marks the earliest trend turn; late counter-trend traders get squeezed.

E-990.title: QStick zero-cross follow
E-990.hypothesis: The mean candle body (close minus open) changing sign shows aggressors switching side; follow them.

E-991.title: Awesome Oscillator zero-cross follow
E-991.hypothesis: Median-price fast/slow average crossing means momentum has changed hands; trend followers add.

E-992.title: Three soldiers / three crows continuation
E-992.hypothesis: Three full-body bars in a row with rising closes show persistent one-sided aggression, not yet exhausted.

E-993.title: EMA ribbon alignment follow
E-993.hypothesis: When fast, mid and slow EMAs line up in order, short and medium horizons agree; follow the first aligned bar.

E-994.title: Price-volume trend cross follow
E-994.hypothesis: Cumulative volume weighted by return rising above its own average shows volume backing the move.

E-995.title: Market-facilitation green bar follow
E-995.hypothesis: A bar with rising range per volume AND rising volume (Bill Williams green bar) shows real participation; follow its colour.

E-996.title: Relative volatility index band cross follow
E-996.hypothesis: When volatility concentrates on up closes rather than down closes, buyers dominate the risk; follow the crossing.

E-997.title: Pretty Good Oscillator breakout follow
E-997.hypothesis: Distance from the moving average in average-range units beyond k means a break from the mean that attracts momentum orders.
